title: Expansion Quality Filtering
hypothesis: Among correctly predicted volatility expansions, only those above a minimum expected magnitude are economically tradable after fees and execution.
null_hypothesis: Expansion quality filter has no effect on trading performance — the model identifies expansions uniformly.
description: Tests whether filtering entries by minimum expansion magnitude (ATR percentile, vol_ratio threshold, hl_range) improves trading performance. Hypothesis: not all predicted expansions are large enough to monetize after fees.
